# Get Phone Numbers From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets phone numbers from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getPhonesFrom(input: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getPhonesFrom(input: "My Number is ${number}")
~~~~
